$comment: Catalog coverage and explicitly configured deployment targets. lolly.tools uses the operator-managed UpCloud K3s sovereign profile after the 2026-10-07 cutover; scripts/ship.ts refuses to deploy this managed target before running the gate or uploading. The profile remains here so scripts/gate.ts still validates lolly-start. Optional deployments to other instances require an explicit supported driver and their own project, domain and team configuration; there is no implicit Vercel adapter.
